name: Produce an accessible media package
short_description: Prepare synchronized text, image descriptions, transcripts, and compressed media for a multi-format publication.
self_assessment: I can produce one four-format accessible media package without help and pass every stated accessibility check.
description: Prepare synchronized text, image descriptions, transcripts, and compressed media for a multi-format publication. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Package an illustrated report with transcript and descriptions
